function: DDPG agent jointly learns IRS positions, PIRS and ASTAR-IRS phase shifts and amplitudes, and RSMA common-rate allocation to maximize expected sum rate (p. 6).
system: Single-antenna BS and four single-antenna MUs (BS-PIRS channel is 1xN); one passive IRS (N=8) plus one active STAR-IRS (M=8), Rician links; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 8).
method: DDPG actor-critic deep reinforcement learning (four DNNs, replay buffer), trained for 500 episodes of 20 time slots (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician fading, path-loss exponent 2.5, reference gain -50 dBW, LOS-to-NLOS ratio J=10, NLOS part randomly sampled; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4, 7, 8).
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training and evaluation; reward versus episode reported, with BS/MU positions, user/element numbers, and CSI error rho 0-0.8 varied in separate runs (pp. 9-12).
baselines: Learned: DDQN, Dueling DQN, D3QN, A2C. Same Algorithm 1 under NOMA, OFDMA, SDMA, OMA and under other IRS deployments (single IRS, AIRS+PSTAR-IRS); no non-learned method (pp. 8, 9, 12).
metrics: Expected sum data rate of all MUs (printed in bps), reward, convergence speed in episodes, training running time (pp. 8-9).
complexity: Training complexity order O(episodes x slots x batch x network-size terms) (p. 8); measured training running time versus IRS elements and baselines (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 4: "follow the Rician fading". Custom Rician simulator (parameters on p. 8); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 12: "show the convergence performances of our proposed Algorithm 1 under different system parameters". Each setting is a separate training run; no trained model is tested in new conditions.
q3_support: p. 8: "we also consider the following baseline schemes: double deep Q network (DDQN), dueling deep Q network (Dueling DQN), dueling DDQN (D3QN), and advantage actor critic (A2C)". All baselines are learned; NOMA, OFDMA, SDMA, OMA (p. 12) and deployment patterns (p. 9) run Algorithm 1 itself, so there is no non-learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 8: "we can know that the complexity" of Algorithm 1 in the training process is given as an order O(...) in layers, neurons, episodes, time slots and batch size; measured training running time in Fig. 6(b), p. 9.
q5_support: p. 8: "Table I shows part of the main simulation parameters used in this article". Own Rician simulator; no code or data link, no public channel dataset, no measured data.
notes: Area 3: the learned DDPG sets RIS phase shifts and amplitudes together with IRS positions and RSMA rate allocation; the system has a RIS, so the system check passes. Rate unit is printed as bps (p. 8). Table I read from the page image (p. 8). q3 not met: the NOMA, OFDMA, SDMA, OMA and deployment-pattern comparisons all run Algorithm 1, so no non-learned baseline appears.
